#  Toprak Razgatlioglu Wins 2024 World Superbike Championship with BMW
Toprak Razgatlioglu secured his second World Superbike Championship in 2024, delivering BMW its first-ever title. Despite a crash setback, the Turkish rider dominated the season with 13 consecutive wins and a podium finish in Jerez. Learn how "El Turco" made history with BMW.
![](https://secure.gravatar.com/avatar/884736d592156ab4c3bdadc96b66e0021ef6d1300b7621cbb1057aee1f6333f2?s=40&d=mm&r=g)
[ Horatiu Boeriu ](https://www.bmwblog.com/author/horatiuboeriu/ "Horatiu Boeriu")
October 19, 2024
[ G Add us on Google  ](https://www.google.com/preferences/source?cs=0&hl=en&q=bmwblog.com) [0 comments](https://www.bmwblog.com/2024/10/19/toprak-razgatlioglu-2024-world-superbike-bmw-champion/#disqus_thread)
![](https://cdn.bmwblog.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/Toprak-Razgatlioglu-bmw-champion-08.jpg)
Toprak Razgatlioglu, the 28-year-old rider from Turkey, has claimed the 2024 World Superbike Championship (WSBK) title. In his first season with BMW, Razgatlioglu secured the championship after finishing second in the first race of the season finale at Jerez, Spain. This marks his second world title, following his 2021 victory with Yamaha, and is BMW’s first-ever Superbike championship.
Razgatlioglu had a standout season, setting a new record with 13 straight wins. However, his path to the championship wasn’t easy. A crash during practice at Magny-Cours left him temporarily out of action, giving his rival, Nicolo Bulega, a chance to close the gap. But despite this setback, Razgatlioglu held onto his lead and clinched the title with two races to spare.
![](https://cdn.bmwblog.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/Toprak-Razgatlioglu-bmw-champion-10-830x553.jpg)
In the first race at Jerez, Toprak started from pole position and held second place throughout the 20-lap race. With his second-place finish, he increased his points tally to 493, securing the title. After crossing the finish line, he celebrated with a dramatic victory lap on one wheel, waving Turkish flags with his supporters, including fellow Turkish rider Kenan Sofuoğlu.
## First Win For BMW
![](https://cdn.bmwblog.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/Toprak-Razgatlioglu-bmw-champion-09-830x553.jpg)

## Early life
[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Toprak_Razgatl%C4%B1o%C4%9Flu&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section: Early life")]
Born in [Alanya](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alanya "Alanya"), Razgatlıoğlu is the second son of the Turkish stunt motorcyclist Arif Razgatlıoğlu, who was known as "Tek Teker Arif" ("Wheelie Arif"). His father, together with his girlfriend who was riding on the [pillion](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pillion "Pillion") seat, died following a [motorcycle accident](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Traffic_collision "Traffic collision") in [Antalya](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Antalya "Antalya") on 17 November 2017.[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Toprak_Razgatl%C4%B1o%C4%9Flu#cite_note-s1-3)
## Career
[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Toprak_Razgatl%C4%B1o%C4%9Flu&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section: Career")]
### Early career
[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Toprak_Razgatl%C4%B1o%C4%9Flu&action=edit&section=3 "Edit section: Early career")]
Razgatlıoğlu competed in the [Red Bull MotoGP Rookies Cup](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Red_Bull_MotoGP_Rookies_Cup "Red Bull MotoGP Rookies Cup") in 2013 and 2014, finishing tenth and sixth overall respectively. He finished first in the seventh race of the 2014 season in [Sachsenring](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sachsenring "Sachsenring"), Germany.[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Toprak_Razgatl%C4%B1o%C4%9Flu#cite_note-4)
Razgatlıoğlu won his debut race in the [European Superstock 600 Championship](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/European_Superstock_600_Championship "European Superstock 600 Championship") on 5 October 2014 at [Magny Cours](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Magny_Cours "Magny Cours") aboard a [Kawasaki ZX-6R](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kawasaki_ZX-6R "Kawasaki ZX-6R").[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Toprak_Razgatl%C4%B1o%C4%9Flu#cite_note-5)[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Toprak_Razgatl%C4%B1o%C4%9Flu#cite_note-6)
Razgatlıoğlu won the 2015 [European Superstock 600 Championship](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/European_Superstock_600_Championship "European Superstock 600 Championship") aboard a [Kawasaki ZX-6R](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kawasaki_ZX-6R "Kawasaki ZX-6R").
